annotations.title: Score brand sentiment in AI answers

description: Score how each AI model talks about a brand for a query: a positive/neutral/negative split per model with the verbatim phrases driving the tone, plus an aggregate across models. Its requestId can be passed to cite42_recommendations when the user asks for improvement advice. Priced per AI surface queried. Billed in USD (result field cite42Billing) to the user's prepaid Cite42 balance; exact prices from cite42_pricing (free). For plans over 20 calls or $5, estimate the cost and confirm with the user first.

brand.description: The brand to score sentiment for in each model answer.

fullSweep.description: Query all five AI surfaces (adds claude and google_ai_overview) for full cross-surface coverage, at a higher cost. Ignored when models is given.

models.description: AI surfaces to query, each billed separately; pass a subset when the user names surfaces or wants a lower cost. Omit for the defaults (chatgpt, perplexity, gemini); fullSweep queries all five. google_ai_overview accepts queries up to 700 characters, the others 2000.

query.description: The concise query whose answers are scored for brand sentiment.

name: cite42_sentiment
